weapon.katana.name: Katana
weapon.katana.desc: Fast and short. It never takes your feet away.
weapon.axe.name: Battle Axe
weapon.axe.desc: A wide arc, enough to sweep two enemies standing shoulder to shoulder.
weapon.hammer.name: Warhammer
weapon.hammer.desc: Slow, wide, and it roots you. Its power is against what cannot walk away.
weapon.pickaxe.name: Pickaxe
weapon.pickaxe.desc: The longest melee reach in the game, on the narrowest arc.
weapon.net.name: Catching Net
weapon.net.desc: It barely hurts. In exchange, what it catches does not go anywhere.
weapon.kunai.name: Kunai
weapon.kunai.desc: Thrown. Less damage than melee - that is what the distance costs.
weapon.shuriken.name: Shuriken
weapon.shuriken.desc: Lighter, further, and quicker out of the hand than a kunai.
relic.flame_ember.name: Ember
relic.iron_grip.name: Iron Grip
relic.stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
relic.swift_tabi.name: Swift Tabi
relic.swift_tabi.desc: Move 10% faster. Enough to leave most things down here behind.
relic.long_reach.name: Long Reach
relic.long_reach.desc: Your weapon reaches four pixels further.
relic.spare_charm.name: Spare Charm
relic.spare_charm.desc: 15 more maximum health, and it heals you for the same.
relic.coin_charm.name: Coin Charm
relic.lucky_clover.name: Lucky Clover
relic.lucky_clover.desc: Enemies and chests drop something a little more often.
relic.ward_bead.name: Ward Beads
relic.ward_bead.desc: Six more steps of invulnerability after being hit.
relic.scavenger_knot.name: Scavenger's Knot
relic.scavenger_knot.desc: Heal 1 for every enemy you kill.
relic.sharp_whetstone.name: Sharp Whetstone
relic.sharp_whetstone.desc: 8% more chance to land a critical hit.
relic.keen_eye.name: Keen Eye
relic.keen_eye.desc: Critical hits do 25% more. Worthless if you never crit.
relic.bloodthorn.name: Bloodthorn
relic.bloodthorn.desc: 8% of the damage you deal comes back as health.
relic.thunder_seal.name: Thunder Seal
relic.thunder_seal.desc: A quarter of your hits arc to a second enemy.
relic.frost_lantern.name: Frost Lantern
relic.frost_lantern.desc: Your hits slow the target by 35% for a second and a half.
relic.venom_flask.name: Venom Flask
relic.venom_flask.desc: Your hits poison: 3 damage a second for five seconds.
relic.phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Feather
relic.phoenix_feather.desc: Once per run, get back up at half health.
relic.kunai_bandolier.name: Kunai Bandolier
relic.kunai_bandolier.desc: Thrown weapons throw one more. Does nothing for melee.
relic.shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
relic.shadow_step.desc: Your roll keeps you untouchable for eight more steps.
relic.ronin_resolve.name: Ronin's Resolve
relic.ronin_resolve.desc: Below a third health, deal 40% more damage.
relic.masters_ashes.name: The Master's Ashes
relic.masters_ashes.desc: Deal 35% more damage. He is still down here, somewhere.
relic.sacred_ember.name: Sacred Ember
relic.sacred_ember.desc: Enemies close enough to touch burn for 4 a second.
relic.hollow_mask.name: Hollow Mask
relic.hollow_mask.desc: Deal 75% more damage, and take exactly that much more.
relic.well_of_years.name: Well of Years
relic.well_of_years.desc: Heal 8 when a room is cleared. It will not help you mid-fight.
item.potion_small.name: Small Potion
item.potion_large.name: Large Potion
item.antidote.name: Antidote
item.draught_swift.name: Draught of Swiftness
item.draught_shadow.name: Draught of Shadow
item.draught_shadow.desc: Deal 50% more damage for ten seconds.
item.elixir_ward.name: Warding Elixir
item.elixir_ward.desc: A shield that soaks 45 damage before your health.
item.smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
item.smoke_bomb.desc: Every enemy in the room forgets you for three seconds.
item.key_iron.name: Iron Key
item.key_iron.desc: Opens one locked door or chest.
item.key_ring.name: Key Ring
item.gold_coin.name: Gold Coin
item.gold_pouch.name: Gold Pouch
item.gold_cache.name: Gold Cache
item.gem_shard.name: Gem Shard
item.gem_shard.desc: A splinter of something older than the well.
item.gem_cluster.name: Gem Cluster
item.gem_cluster.desc: Five shards, still joined. Worth keeping whole.
floor.1.desc: A hole behind the village that nobody admits to digging. Water drips below, and something answers it.
floor.2.desc: The water won. What the shrine kept down here is loose now, and it has learned to swim.
floor.3.desc: The gate still stands. Nothing else does, and what squats in the nave was never meant to be worshipped.
floor.4.desc: Past the old stone the walls change hands. Nothing down here is alive, and none of it is in a hurry.
floor.5.desc: The flame that took your master, and the one who carries it. There is no floor below this one.
item.heart_small.name: Small Heart
item.heart_small.desc: Heals 10 the moment you step on it.
item.heart_large.name: Large Heart
item.heart_large.desc: Heals 25 the moment you step on it.
item.soul_ember.name: Soul Ember
item.soul_ember.desc: 5 more maximum health for the rest of this run.
item.map_scrap.name: Map Scrap
item.map_scrap.desc: Reveals the whole of this floor.
upgrade.vigor.name: Vigor
upgrade.vigor.desc: 15 more maximum health at the start of every run, per level.
upgrade.edge.name: Keen Edge
upgrade.swiftness.name: Swiftness
upgrade.fortune.name: Fortune
upgrade.fortune.desc: 12% more gold per level. It pays for itself in a few runs.
upgrade.satchel.name: Satchel
upgrade.satchel.desc: Carry one more potion per level.
upgrade.keyring.name: Keyring
upgrade.keyring.desc: Start every run with one more key, per level.
upgrade.wardstone.name: Wardstone
upgrade.wardstone.desc: Once per run, get back up at 40% health.
upgrade.flamekeeper.name: Flamekeeper
upgrade.flamekeeper.desc: The village dims more slowly with every failed descent.
character.ninjagreen.desc: No perk. The measure the other five are set against.
character.ninjafire.desc: Once per run, get back up at 30% health.
